profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, USA. It trades under ticker NVDA and is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001045810. For the fiscal period ended January 25, 2026, NVIDIA reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 in a 10-K filing. The company's website focuses on NVIDIA Nemotron, which it describes as a family of highly efficient, multimodal, open AI models built for long-running, self-evolving agents. The site says the models deliver agentic reasoning for graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding, and are supported on NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark.

The Nemotron family includes Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, Nemotron Speech models for automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, and neural machine translation, and Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and retrieval. NVIDIA offers the models as NVIDIA NIM microservices, which require an NVIDIA AI Enterprise license, and provides NVIDIA NeMo for custom agentic AI, NVIDIA Blueprints for reference workflows, and tools such as NVIDIA Dynamo, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, and vLLM. Bryan Catanzaro, VP of applied deep learning research at NVIDIA, is quoted on the site about the vision behind Nemotron. The NVIDIA Open Model License is described as permissive, allowing use, modification, distribution, and commercial deployment without crediting NVIDIA.

NVIDIA Nemotron is listed as an enterprise LLM family with synthetic data generation and GPU-optimized self-hosted options, and NVIDIA NIM is listed as inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. NVIDIA is associated with 281 California legal exposure records and no listed cases.
